title: Ashbury Rewards Account Security Terms: Hold on Points Received by Transfer
content:
**Ashbury Rewards — hold on points received by transfer.** Points a member has received by transfer from another member are held back from the transferable balance — the points the member can give to another member — for a received-points hold period set by the tier and by the whole calendar months since enrolment. For long-standing members at the upper tiers the hold period is shorter:

- three months for a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or higher enrolled for at least one hundred and twenty months;
- six months for a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or higher enrolled for sixty to one hundred and nineteen months.

Members at Ashbury Rewards Member, Silver Elite or Gold Elite, and members at Platinum Elite or higher enrolled for fewer than sixty months, have no shortened hold period under these terms. Platinum Elite or higher means Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite.

The points held back are those received by transfer in that many months before the handling date. A period of months before the handling date covers the transactions posted after the same day number that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The months since enrolment are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the membership to the handling date.

| Tier | Whole months since enrolment | Received-points hold period |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite or higher | 120 or more | 3 months |
| Platinum Elite or higher | 60 to 119 | 6 months |
| Platinum Elite or higher | fewer than 60 | No shortened hold |
| Member, Silver Elite, Gold Elite | any | No shortened hold |

**Illustration (hypothetical member, handling date 6 October 2026).** A Titanium Elite member enrolled 150 months ago has a 3-month hold: points received by transfer and posted after 6 July 2026, up to and including 6 October 2026, are held back; points received on 6 July 2026 or earlier are not.
